def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # Maps key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        op_type = op[0]
        t = op[1]
        key = op[2]
        
        # Remove expired entries
        expired_keys = [k for k, (v, write_time) in cache.items() if write_time + ttl <= t]
        for k in expired_keys:
            del cache[k]
        
        if op_type == 'put':
            value = op[3]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will be re-added at the end)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is at capacity, evict LRU (first item in OrderedDict)
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                cache.popitem(last=False)
            
            # Add the new/updated entry (becomes most recently used)
            cache[key] = (value, t)
        
        elif op_type == 'get':
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                # Make it most recently used by moving to end
                del cache[key]
                cache[key] = (value, write_time)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
